title: 第13章 雷火貂第14章 龙衔宝楼
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
入夜后。
和铃来看望小麒麟。
她带了一把灵草，怼到小麒麟嘴边。
小麒麟把脑袋别过去，腹腔中发出呼呼的声音。
和铃挪到右边，继续喂它。
“呕……”小麒麟忽然低头，吐了大口青草汁出来。
和铃：“！！！”
“你干什么！”她迅速起身，退了两大步远。
小麒麟心虚地转着眼珠子，细声细气叫唤：“吟～吟～”
吃撑了。反胃，就吐了。
“嗝～”小麒麟又打了个饱嗝。
在和铃来之前，已经有十几批南华宗弟子来给它喂食。
和铃摸出一张清洁符处理了下衣裳，嫌弃地踢了踢裙摆，把草丢在地上，说道：“要是七日后你选了我，今天的事情就不和你计较了。”
“但是——”
她哼了声，威胁道：“你忘恩负义的话，我们之间的账就要好好重新算一下了。”
小麒麟歪了歪脑袋。
什么恩，什么义？
大家都给它送吃的了呀，好多人都对它有恩呢。
和铃走后，又有一个弟子提着水桶前来。
声音谄媚地说道：“小神兽，我给你洗一洗身上吧～”

小麒麟起身，身上的锁链哗啦作响，它凑近到水桶前，低头吸了半桶的水。
这弟子恍然大悟：“是了，大家都给小麒麟送吃的，没有给它喂水，小麒麟肯定口渴了……”
“噗——”
忽然，一道水柱喷在了他的脸上。
小麒麟舔了舔嘴巴。
嗯，漱口之后舒服多了。
……
翌日。
南华城坊市开市。
姜暮烟带和铃出门，去置办衣裳首饰法宝，张流川追到山脚下。
“大师姐，等等我，我也去！”
姜暮烟翻他一个白眼，“我和小师妹去逛街，你一个大男人跟着去做什么。”
张流川理了理衣袖，正色说道：“你们买东西，我可以帮忙拎包。”
“有储物袋。”
“额……大师姐～”他扯着姜暮烟的衣袖晃了晃，“你就让我去吧，我也很久没去南华城了。”
“你看今天这天这么明媚，正适合我们一家人出去逛，这样吧，我喊上三师弟，咱们一块去，就这样说好了啊！”
张流川飞快跑开，不给姜暮烟拒绝的机会。
姜暮烟感到头疼，小心翼翼地看了和铃一眼，询问她的意见，“阿铃，你觉得怎么样？要是不想让二师弟一起，我们就趁他去喊三师弟的功夫先溜了。”
以三师弟的性子，流川估计还得磨一磨他，他才会答应。
姜暮烟担心和铃没了耐心。

和铃却很乖巧地说道：“我听师姐的。”
顿时，姜暮烟心都被融化了。
content_en:
After nightfall.
He Ling came to visit Xiao Qilin.
She brought a handful of spiritual grass and put it to Little Qilin's mouth.
Little Qilin turned his head away and made a whirring sound in his belly.
He Ling moved to the right and continued to feed it.
"Ugh..." Little Qilin suddenly lowered his head and spit out a large mouthful of grass juice.
He Ling: "!!!"
"What are you doing!" She stood up quickly and took two big steps back.
Little Qilin rolled his eyes guiltily and called out softly: "Yin~Yin~"
Too full. I felt nauseated and vomited.
"Hiccup~" Little Qilin burped again.
Before He Ling came, more than a dozen groups of Nanhua Sect disciples had come to feed it.
He Ling took out a cleaning charm and disposed of his clothes, kicked the hem of his skirt in disgust, threw the grass on the ground, and said, "If you choose me in seven days, I won't care about you today."
"But-"
She snorted and threatened: "If you are ungrateful, the accounts between us will be recalculated."
Little Qilin tilted his head.
What grace, what righteousness?
Everyone gave it food, and many people were kind to it.
After He Ling left, another disciple came with a bucket.
The voice said flatteringly: "Little beast, let me wash your body~"
The little Qilin stood up, the chains on his body rattling, he came closer to the bucket, lowered his head and drank half of the bucket of water.
The disciple suddenly realized: "Yes, everyone brought food to the little Qilin, but did not give it water. The little Qilin must be thirsty..."
"Pfft——"
Suddenly, a jet of water sprayed on his face.
Little Qilin licked his mouth.
Well, I feel much better after rinsing my mouth.
…
The next day.
Nanhua City is open.
Jiang Muyan took He Ling out to buy clothes, jewelry and magic weapons. Zhang Liuchuan chased him to the foot of the mountain.
"Sister, wait for me, I'll go too!"
Jiang Muyan rolled her eyes at him, "My junior sister and I are going shopping, why are you, a grown man, following us?"
Zhang Liuchuan straightened his sleeves and said seriously: "You guys are shopping, I can help carry your bags."
"There are storage bags."
"Uh... Senior Sister~" He pulled Jiang Muyan's sleeve and shook it, "Just let me go. I haven't been to Nanhua City for a long time."
"You see, today is such a bright day, which is perfect for our family to go out for a walk. Let's do this. I'll call my third junior brother and we'll go together. That's what we agreed!"
Zhang Liuchuan ran away quickly, not giving Jiang Muyan a chance to refuse.
Jiang Muyan felt a headache. She glanced at He Ling cautiously and asked her opinion, "A Ling, what do you think? If we don't want the second junior brother to come with us, we can escape while he calls the third junior brother."
With the temperament of the third junior brother, Rukawa probably has to temper him before he agrees.
Jiang Muyan was worried that He Ling would lose his patience.
But He Ling said obediently: "I listen to senior sister."
Suddenly, Jiang Muyan's heart melted.
